Hospital Billing Process

End-to-end hospital billing handled by PMEX

  1. 1

    Patient Registration

    Accurate patient demographics, insurance details, and medical history collected and verified.

  2. 2

    Eligibility Verification & Prior Auth

    Real-time insurance eligibility checks and prior authorizations obtained before services are rendered.

  3. 3

    Medical Coding

    AAPC-certified coders assign error-free ICD-10, CPT, and HCPCS codes specific to your specialty.

  4. 4

    Charge Entry

    All service charges entered promptly to prevent billing gaps and surprise bills.

  5. 5

    Claims Submission

    Claims scrubbed, verified, and submitted electronically to all major payers across all 50 states.

  6. 6

    Denial Management

    Denied claims identified, root-cause analyzed, appealed, and resubmitted within 48 hours.

  7. 7

    Payment Posting

    ERA and EOB payments posted daily. Variances flagged. Underpayments appealed same day.

  8. 8

    Reporting via PMEX Portal

    Real-time revenue data updated by your billing team. Log in anytime to see where every dollar stands.
